title: Simulate useTransition Pending State
problemStatement: Implement `createTransitionRunner()` that provides `startTransition(callback)` and `isPending()`. It flags `isPending()` as `true` during the async execution of non-urgent transitions and returns to `false` when finished.
interviewTrap: Transitions are for low-priority updates. Using transitions for input state causes inputs to drop characters.

testCases.name: Reports isPending = true while transition is executing
testCases.testFn: const runner = createTransitionRunner(); runner.startTransition(async () => { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); }); return runner.isPending();

testCases.name: Returns isPending = false after transition finishes
testCases.testFn: const runner = createTransitionRunner(); await runner.startTransition(async () => { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5)); }); return runner.isPending();

testCases.name: Handles synchronous callbacks
testCases.testFn: const runner = createTransitionRunner(); await runner.startTransition(() => {}); return runner.isPending();

details.name: Reports isPending = true while transition is executing
Returns isPending = false after transition finishes

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: React categorizes updates into Urgent (typing in an `<input>`, clicks) and Non-Urgent / Transition (filtering a 10,000 item list). Wrapping an update in `startTransition(() => setQuery(text))` allows React to interrupt the list render if the user types another keystroke.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Render Phase: Fiber node evaluation and hooks linked-list dispatch for Non-Urgent Update Flagging with isPending.
2. Reconciliation: Double buffering and fiber diffing mechanics.
3. Commit Phase: Synchronous/passive effect execution and DOM mutation.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals: In React Fiber, Non-Urgent Update Flagging with isPending maintains state across work-in-progress trees and lanes scheduling priority.

complexity.time: O(1) per hook / O(N) fiber traversal

edgeCasesHandled: Transitions are for low-priority updates. Using transitions for input state causes inputs to drop characters.

specifications: React Fiber Architecture Specification & Runtime Implementation
verifiedRules: Hooks must be called in exact order matching the fiber memoizedState linked list.
